scope: Independent pre-dispatch implementation review and pure CPU coordinate arithmetic. No model or GPU call. Does not certify actual training or inference completion.

checks.same_initialization: Strict EXP67 step6000 generator/AdamW/RNG hashes and original parameter ordering enforced
checks.parameters: NativeModel class promotion preserves named Parameters/state keys; no new params/modules
checks.coordinate_center: FP32 area weighted, original augmented C rows only, before slot/corner permutation
checks.coordinates: Local x_embedder; explicit unchanged augmented-world C to original Geo; same native blocks/final
checks.OT: New isolated immutable mapping identity, augmented preOT minus anchor/2, final model target world_target minus anchor
checks.noise: Original iid Gaussian/epsilon arrays unchanged; HYBRID lambda 0.25
checks.loss: Original effective-batch free-coordinate denominator, 8 microbatch contributions, clip1, AdamW unchanged
checks.inference: Local FP32 Euler50 with BF16 velocities; world F=local+a; external C copied directly. Exact local Euler, saved Gaussian, world translation and all51 C checks
checks.new_budget: 96 rollouts = 4800 generation forwards; 96 single official D0 forwards
checks.logical_evaluation: 4 models x 48 requests x 2 stages = 384 scores; 192 new and 192 cached
checks.postprocess: Both new models all96 RAW complete before any D0; GEO_C and source-winding export reused
checks.scoring: Existing score math reused; no old world-start Gaussian validation applied to new local trajectories
checks.visual: 48 anonymous request pages, 8 noise contact sheets; 384 review rows, 32 style rows

evidence_limits: No GPU/model was constructed or called by this audit; actual numeric execution remains separately audited.
Training entry itself lacks a shared GPU ownership lock; use the sequential root run entry and do not dispatch evaluation alongside training.
5GiB allocator cap plus context estimate is not a measured 6GiB process limit; WDDM process VRAM may be NA.
FP32 area centroid is not promised bitwise invariant to retessellation or face permutation.
CREF changes coordinate/prior strategy together; world Geo retains absolute centroid info, so full translation equivariance is not claimed.
